indices.name: S&P 500
indices.note: Fell about 145 points in a broad selloff led by tech.

indices.name: Nasdaq
indices.note: Lost about 627 points as chip and AI stocks slid again.

indices.name: Dow
indices.note: Dropped about 739 points, with big banks also lower.

notes: Nvidia fell about 4% to roughly $156, nearly 13% lower over five days, after reports that its board isn't weighing Jensen Huang's return; new US curbs on AI chip exports also hit the group, with AMD down about 5.6% and Intel about 7%.
Alphabet and Amazon each lost around 3%, and investors trimmed AI holdings ahead of Anthropic's Nasdaq debut later this week; the VIX fear gauge jumped about 20% to near 23.
Big banks slipped about 2% amid reports of app and transaction outages; oil fell more than 3% to about $85 as Strait of Hormuz shipping recovered, and Bitcoin hovered near $64,000.
events: Tue 17 Nov, after the US close (overnight into Wed, Kuwait time): Nvidia reports quarterly results, its first since Jensen Huang's exit.
Thu 19 Nov: Anthropic's IPO is expected to start trading on Nasdaq.
Wed 9 Dec, 22:00 Kuwait time: Federal Reserve rate decision; markets are pricing in a hike.
